tools.name: agentsearch_web_search
tools.description: Search the web with AgentSearch and return the response as pretty-printed JSON text. Use this when you have a query and need hits rather than a page body; if you already have a URL, use agentsearch_extract instead (or agentsearch_render for JavaScript-heavy pages). Free, no wallet: this remote serve

tools.name: agentsearch_extract
tools.description: Fetch one absolute URL with AgentSearch Web Extract and return it as JSON text: title, clean markdown and/or text, links, meta (status_code, content_type, fetched_at, chars, truncated) and error (null on success). findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: agentsearch_web_search, agentsearch_extract, agentsearch_render · Private data: agentsearch_web_search, agentsearch_extract, agentsearch_render · Public sink: agentsearch_render · Destructive: agentsearch_extract.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: agentsearch_web_search, agentsearch_extract, agentsearch_render · Private data: agentsearch_web_search, agentsearch_extract, agentsearch_render · Public sink: agentsearch_render · Destructive: agentsearch_extract

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
